description: Verify that TCP in CLOSED / LISTEN / SYN-SENT does not process a FIN: CLOSED replies RST, LISTEN / SYN-SENT silently drop (RFC 793 §3.9 p75). 3 iterations exercise wst ∈ {CLOSED, LISTEN, SYN-SENT}
approach:
[Objective]
A FIN before any connection makes no sense. CLOSED replies RST (consistent with BASICS_04). LISTEN / SYN-SENT silently drop — there's no half-open connection to close.

[Scenario — chronological]
Three iterations:
• Phase 1: DUT in CLOSED → tester FIN → DUT replies RST seq=0.
• Phase 2: DUT in LISTEN → tester FIN → no DUT response.
• Phase 3: DUT in SYN-SENT → tester FIN → no DUT response.

[Pass condition]
Phase 1 DUT RST seq=0; phases 2/3 silent.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: corresponding Fail_p<n>_*.

verdicts.Pass: DUT handled FIN per state — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_dut_rst: No DUT RST to FIN in CLOSED
verdicts.Fail_p1_wrong_seq: DUT RST seq not zero after FIN in CLOSED
verdicts.Fail_p2_unexpected_response: DUT response to FIN in LISTEN
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_dut_syn: No DUT SYN to active OPEN phase 3
verdicts.Fail_p3_unexpected_response: DUT response to FIN in SYN-SENT
